opening.argument: The presentation promotes Mirror Trading International as a passive Bitcoin income opportunity, claiming average returns of over 12% per month while suggesting viewers can earn Bitcoin quickly. It directs viewers to fund an account with at least $100, placing the Bitcoin into a company trading pool where software manages trading and profits are shared. The promotion also requires recruitment: viewers are told they need two investors contributing at least $200, while sharing the opportunity is tied to a recurring binary bonus. The combination of unusually high return claims, recruitment-based compensation, and a concrete transfer of viewer funds to the platform supports treating this as a deceptive investment-pool promotion, even though the speaker includes a personal-results qualification.
